calibration.rule: every number in this run is HISTORICAL OUT-OF-SAMPLE PERFORMANCE. None of it is live accuracy, and none of it may be quoted as such until enough REAL_FORWARD predictions have resolved.

founder.why: §24 is conditional and the condition was not met. No hypothesis earned REGIME_CONDITIONAL, EARLY_WARNING or TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT, so no collective-state reading may reach a Founder recommendation. The six-company test is not run, because running it would produce six differentiated-looking outputs from a layer that has not shown it knows anything.

learning_metrics.learning_quality: HIGH: every resolved hypothesis resolved against the direction the run would have preferred, and four attractive results were killed by scrutiny rather than reported
learning_metrics.stagnation: NO: the binding constraint moved from 'not enough origins' to 'the conventional base model only clears a trivial baseline on 3 of 10 preregistered families', which is a different and more specific problem

lessons.cost: an entire replay that appeared walled and was not
lessons.guard: market/alfred.fetch_series raises VintageIgnored when a vintage response contains observations dated after it
lessons.lesson: FRED's vintage parameter is silently ignored

lessons.cost: a result reported as surviving FDR correction
lessons.guard: econ/experiment.assert_no_trending_levels, called from the runner before any model is fitted
lessons.lesson: non-stationary levels created a fake +0.134 housing win

lessons.cost: a +0.029 credit-stress delta that did not survive contemporaneous classification
lessons.guard: econ/regime.classify reads only Panel.history(as_of=), the same walled primitive every feature uses
lessons.lesson: hindsight regime labels created a fake crisis advantage

lessons.cost: an INFLATION_SHOCK interval of [+0.081, +0.271] at p=0.002
lessons.guard: econ/incremental.assert_clusters_are_origins refuses a comparison whose cluster count equals its row count
lessons.lesson: a row bootstrap treated dependent forecasts as independent

lessons.cost: a decisive-looking result resting on a single event
lessons.guard: MIN_EPISODES=3 in incremental, and Sample.headline has no variant that prints a row count alone
lessons.lesson: 30 rows collapsed to 14 origins and then to one episode

lessons.cost: quits and participation left the model; the delta moved 0.005 with nothing saying why
lessons.lesson: a dict keyed by kind silently removed multiple instruments

lessons.cost: PSAVERT 2008-06 carried its 2026 value (4.6) under a 2008-07-31 vintage; the first print was 2.5
lessons.guard: econ/panel.assert_no_assumed_lag, and scripts/build_historical_panel.py now refuses to run
lessons.lesson: two scripts wrote the same panel path under different rules, and the leaked one won

lessons.cost: REVOLSL was redefined between those vintages -- 100% of observations differ by up to 105,016% -- and fed the behavioural block at every pre-2010 origin
lessons.guard: alfred_cache.shortcut_allowed requires the measurement to cover the origin window, or a never-revised record
lessons.lesson: a stability measurement taken over 2015-2024 was applied to origins back to 1998

lessons.cost: 344 origins where the acquisition planned 115, because one quarterly series publishes on the fifteenth
lessons.guard: the grid is declared in scripts/acquire_panel.py and read from the manifest by every consumer
lessons.lesson: the forecast origin grid was inferred from a date-string pattern

lessons.cost: PSAVERT went negative in 1999; its feature was undefined at three origins, so the whole series was dropped for imbalance and the guard that caught it was the only reason anyone knew
lessons.lesson: a relative change was taken on a series that crosses zero

lessons.cost: a baseline gate that failed for a reason that was about the harness, not the economy
lessons.guard: the ladder and the fit are both PER FAMILY, and the gate is reported per family
lessons.lesson: one logistic fitted across ten families with base rates from 0.28 to 0.92 cannot beat a constant

lessons.cost: 'episode-aware CI [+0.00000, +0.00000]' printed beside a real delta reads as impossible precision and means 'undefined'
lessons.guard: the bootstrap returns None below two blocks and every caller must say UNDEFINED
lessons.lesson: a degenerate interval was rendered as [0, 0]

lessons.cost: every global result would have failed MIN_EPISODES for the wrong reason
lessons.guard: power.phase_map maps origins to discovered episodes and the calm stretches between them
lessons.lesson: an episode count from contiguous dates said '1 episode' for a sample spanning 1978-2026

lessons.cost: two mechanisms reported SUPPORTED on the MODERN arm; both vanish once §10's gate is honoured
lessons.guard: run_v2_mechanism filters to gate-passing families and reports the count it scored on
lessons.lesson: a transmission-residual test scored on families whose base model loses to a constant

lessons.cost: 2,316 of 2,716 origins landed in the failure arm because real consumption rises in 92% of windows
lessons.guard: residual.MIN_DRIVER_MOVE, with the unfloored split reported beside the floored one
lessons.lesson: 'the mechanism failed' collapsed into 'the target did its usual thing'
